scope: Independent read-only source review of the frozen conditional AllThree binder and unbound launch template. This does not approve a rendered body, B-side staging, admission, or launch.

findings.recipe_derivation: The binder pins the exact NLL V2 body and original NLL launch-acceptance receipt, derives the AllThree template through exact anchored substitutions, and verifies the resulting argv differs only at zero-based indexes 1 and 48: run name to fg19_child_allthree_f0_s1001_fit_v1 and representation mode base to ema_sparse. The NLL objective, wmse loss, chunk normalization, mean-variance head 1, architecture, seeded fixed six-epoch endpoint, optimizer, scheduler, and parent @ep3 initializer remain bound to the original recipe.
findings.sequential_nll_gate: Both the local receipt validator and the embedded remote predecessor gate bind NLL acceptance bytes to their SHA-256 and the exact original launch-acceptance SHA. They require the NLL terminal schema/status, original run/unit/invocation, source commit and 167-file manifest, split, base representation/NLL objective, 44,760 updates/4,476 batches/six epochs/selected epoch 5, zero AMP skips and nonfinite updates, strict integer terminal fields 0/1/0, finite-state verification flags, selected model_ep5 identity, and the existing predecessor ancestry. The exact-stop receipt binds the acceptance hash and invocation, requires the native service to have been active/exited with PID 0 and exit code/status 1/0 before the stop, empty population snapshots and successful stop, then not-found/inactive/dead with PID 0 and empty invocation; the nested verifier is likewise required to be exactly stopped. The NLL child is recorded only as a sequential prerequisite; argv initialization remains the existing parent @ep3 checkpoint.
findings.other_gates_and_resources: The added NLL gate is inserted before the existing predecessor and admission flow. Existing source, split, cache, dictionary, profile, parent, registered-data, output/unit-absence, all-population/ownership, selected-GPU, physical ext4 scratch/device and 25 GiB floor checks remain in the pinned NLL-derived template before output creation and submission. The declared worker/aggregate limits remain one owned GPU, 100% worker CPU within a 200% parent quota, 7.5 GB memory-high/8 GB memory-max, zero swap, 4 GB CUDA allocator with 1 GB reserve, 86,400-second runtime, zero loader workers, and one BLAS thread.
findings.body_state: The template retains explicit unbound NLL acceptance and exact-stop slots. The local checker refuses rendering while either receipt is absent or invalid, and the current packet contains no rendered REMOTE_SUBMISSION.py or final binding receipt.

conditional_requirements: Do not render or admit until actual NLL terminal acceptance and exact-stop receipts exist and pass both local and embedded remote validators.
Bind the exact rendered body and its predecessor receipts in a separate source review and root admission manifest before any B-side staging or launch.
Keep the accepted NLL checkpoint out of initialization; initialize only from the existing parent @ep3 checkpoint.

verification_boundary.local_checks_receipt_reports: Four focused tests and Ruff checks passed; this reviewer did not rerun them.
